notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Spike Feeder and Cryptic Trilobite have at least two +1/+1 counters.
description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
